locations.snippet: SpotIt+ searches for distinguishing databases and uses a best-effort pipeline to mine constraints for text-to-SQL evaluation \citep{tremante2026spotit}. Our current inputs contain fixed constraints, and the study neither reproduces that complete mining pipeline nor calls language-model APIs. An imported verification submodule alone is not a full SpotIt+ reproduction. The inspected adapter uses a set-semantics verifier: for two scalar one-row outputs this can coincide with bag comparison if NULL and row preservation are handled consistently, but it cannot be labeled a general bag-semantics baseline.
locations.meaning: Already distinguishes set engine and scalar one-row conditional agreement; not a bag mislabel.

scientific_limits: Only scalar aggregate queries returning one preserved row per input database can make set and bag output equality coincide, with consistent NULL equality.
No extension to general multirow, duplicate-sensitive or ORDER BY semantics.
Recorded DEV verdict agreement is not new gold or a performance claim; no rerun was performed.
Imported fixed engine does not reproduce the SpotIt+ LLM/constraint-mining pipeline.
Do not silently change engine source or semantics to turn this historical run into a bag baseline.
